title: Sai Uluhon Au O Tuhan
chord: Am · G · C · D · Em · Am · D7 · A
lyrics:
Haleluya Puji ma Di joroNa Debata Puji ma goarNa i
Ro di hajanghajang ni Hagogoon ni Tuhanta
Sai pasangap ma tongtong Debata di tano on Ala ni hatimbulonNa
Palu ma sarune i Lao mamuji Tuhan i Sordam nang tulila pe
I ma pangke sasude Pasangaphon Debatanta
Tali sayak, ogung i, Arbap nang hasapi pe Palu baen hasangaponNa

Gok parhinaloan i Baen mamuji Tuhan i Nasa gogoMu tahe
Holan i do na ture Na tama di Debatanta
Nasa na marhosa i Naeng mamuji Tuhan i Mangendehon Heleluya
